title: Get A Free Audible Audiobook Subscription As Part of This Surprise Prime Day Deal
summary: Listen to millions of audiobooks, podcasts and playlists online without paying a cent.
contentText:
Books are perfect for reading or displaying on your coffee table , but on the days you’re commuting or traveling to new destinations , finding space to pack a thick book isn’t always easy. To help you update your summer reading list with audiobooks, Amazon is giving new users three months of access to Audible for free , as part of a new Prime Day deal .

Yes, that’s right, for a limited time, new users can get an Audible Standard subscription free for three months, making this the best Audible deal we’ve ever seen. A bonus: you’ll also get a $20 Audible credit that you can redeem for audiobook downloads on the site.

GET: AUDIBLE SUBSCRIPTION FOR FREE

Your Audible subscription renews at the regular price of $8.99/month after your three-month free trial is over, or you can cancel at anytime. The audiobooks you download with your $20 site credit are yours to keep, even if you cancel your membership.

This limited-time deal runs until July 5, so you’ll want to hurry. A note: the three-month free trial deal is only open to Amazon Prime members, so you’ll need to be logged into your Prime account to see the offer. Not a Prime member? You can get a 30-day free trial to Amazon Prime here and use it to claim the free Audible deal, in addition to all the other Prime member benefits.

GET: AMAZON PRIME 30-DAY FREE TRIAL

Amazon is also offering a great deal for non-Prime members right now: you can get three months of Audible Standard for just $0.99/month . That’s a savings of 89% off the regular monthly price. Plus get the $20 bonus credit for Audible.com. See more details here.

$0.99 $8.99 89% off

GET: AUDIBLE SUBSCRIPTION DEAL

Popular Audible titles right now include the full-cast audio edition of the Harry Potter series, plus Andy Weir’s Project Hail Mary and Elle Kennedy’s The Deal (the book behind the hit Prime Video series, Off Campus ).

This Audible summer promotion is a limited-time offer, so we recommend acting fast to score this new Audible deal. It expires at the end of the day on Sunday, July 5. See full details of the Audible promotion here .
